description: This file defines the Smarty_Variable class, which models a template variable in the Smarty templating engine. It includes properties for the variable's value and caching behavior, a constructor to initialize these properties, and a magic method for string conversion.

classes.name: Smarty_Variable
classes.description: Represents a variable within the Smarty templating engine, including its value and caching behavior.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of Smarty_Variable with a specified value and caching preference.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Converts the Smarty_Variable object to its string representation.
